phase: slice 1 pushed at ee86db7: StudioComposition record set, validation, tests; composite adapter is a follow-up lane

commits.subject: folio (SMB-FOLIO-COMPOSITION slice 1): hsk.studio.composition@1 records (layer timing, keyframe streams, parenting, precomp, track matte) with cycle and tick-overflow refusals

capabilities_done: new module composition.rs: StudioCompositionRecords (hsk.studio.composition_records@1, per document, non_exhaustive) of StudioComposition (hsk.studio.composition@1): composition_id (document-local key, no Accord prefix exists), name, width/height 4..=30000 (STU-MOT-004), pixel_aspect rational >0 lowest terms, frame_rate exact rational fps 1..=999 in lowest terms with a whole number of ticks per frame (ticks_per_frame()), duration 1..=i64::MAX ticks, optional background StudioRgba, layers topmost first (STU-MOT-009)

StudioCompositionLayer: layer_id = a document SLYR layer (DanglingReference otherwise; one document layer in at most one composition, DuplicateIdentity), timing {in_point, out_point (half-open, in<out), start_time i64, stretch rational non-zero, negative reverses, lowest terms} with contains(tick) and source_tick(tick) = floor((tick - start)/stretch) via i128 (None on i64 overflow), parent (forest, loops incl. self = ContainmentCycle), precomp {composition_id, collapse_transformations} (composition-in-composition; loops incl. self and mutual = RenderCycle; unknown target DanglingReference), track_matte {source_layer_id, alpha|luma, inverted} (self = InvalidField, matte loops = RenderCycle, unknown = DanglingReference)

StudioPropertyStream per layer (at most one per property, DuplicateIdentity): property anchor(2)/position(2)/scale(2)/rotation(1)/opacity(1 in 0..=100), static_value kept when animated (STU-MOT-020b), keyframes with strictly increasing u64 ticks <= i64::MAX, per-side interpolation linear|bezier|continuous_bezier|auto_bezier|hold (easing) and temporal tangents {speed, influence 0..=1} (0, 1 or dimension tangents; Bezier-family side requires a tangent), values finite and |v| <= 1e12; mirrors motion Property::new inputs without a folio->motion edge

validate_composition_records(records, document, budget, token, resolver): single validator; tick overflow (tick > i64::MAX, source-time mapping beyond i64 at in/out) is InvalidField with a tick_overflow target segment (no new Code: Code is matched exhaustively by components, composite, pigment and interop-psd); layers, streams and keyframes charged to Budget::nodes, names to payload_bytes; hard ceilings 64 compositions, 4096 layers, 65536 keyframes per stream; cancellation checked
wire: deny_unknown_fields, empty lists not encoded, byte-identical encode-decode-encode including 17-digit floats; composition_records_schema() draft 2020-12
next: composite follow-up lane (adapter, see notes.composite_adapter); Accord prefix registration for composition_id; pigment Transform operator for position/scale/rotation/anchor/parent chain

notes.tests_checked: 5 test files claims: tests/composition_contract.rs composition_round_trips_and_maps_time, cycle_refusals, bounds_overflow_and_identity_refusals, budget_and_cancel (4 tests); existing 50 folio tests green; clippy -p hsk-studio-folio --tests clean; clippy over folio + dependents (composite, components, package, pigment, pulse, interop-psd, interop-fig, interop-media, session, chronicle) exit 0 with no new warnings
notes.composite_adapter: composite TemporalSource::layer_state(layer_id, tick, cancel) needs from a StudioCompositionRecords: (1) LayerTiming {in_tick, out_tick} per layer = StudioCompositionLayer.timing.in_point / out_point (u64, half-open, both <= i64::MAX, cast to i64 safe) found by records.layer(layer_id) -> (composition, layer); (2) MotionTemporalSource streams: for each StudioPropertyStream build motion::Property::new(stream.property.wire(), static_value, keys) where each StudioCompositionKeyframe maps to motion Keyframe {time: Ticks::new(time), value, in_interp/out_interp (same five names), in_tangent/out_tangent as TemporalTangent{speed, influence}} and opacity/position/scale/rotation fill LayerProperties (anchor, parent chain, stretch/start_time source mapping, precomp recursion and track_matte have no LayerFrameState field yet: composite needs LayerFrameState anchor + parent chain composition (world transform) and a source-time mapping via StudioLayerTiming::source_tick before it can honour them, and the pigment Transform operator for non-integer-translate transforms); (3) tick domain: keyframe times and timing are composition ticks, the render tick passed to lower_frame is a composition tick; a precomp layer needs the nested composition sampled at source_tick(tick) of the precomp layer's timing; (4) no folio->composite or composite->folio module edge change is needed (composite already depends on folio); the optional composite->motion edge already exists
notes.decisions_and_gaps: composition_id is a document-local key because Accord DomainId::parse holds a closed prefix list (no composition prefix) and Accord is outside this lane: lead/steward to register a prefix; frame-boundary quantisation of keyframes (STU-MOT-020) not enforced; floor division for stretch source mapping is UNVERIFIED against After Effects (D5 oracle); parenting preserve-world-transform variants (STU-MOT-008 rule 2) are an edit-command concern, not stored; blend mode, quality, switches (shy, solo, locked, 3D, motion blur), markers, work area, expressions, spatial tangents and other STU-MOT-004 settings are not stored (declared in composition.rs header); keyframes are charged to Budget::nodes so large animations need a larger Budget
